items.headline: U.S. and Iran Exchange Military Strikes in Major Escalation Near Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: Following a month-long lull in fighting, United States forces launched extensive airstrikes targeting Iranian military sites, radar equipment, and naval vessels near the Strait of Hormuz. Iran retaliated with drone and missile strikes directed at U.S. allies across the Persian Gulf, renewing volatility in global energy markets as both sides signal readiness for further confrontation.

items.headline: Uber and Wayve Launch the United Kingdom's First Autonomous Ride-Hailing Service
items.summary: Uber and artificial intelligence company Wayve have launched supervised autonomous vehicle rides in London, marking the first time self-driving ride-hailing is available to the public in the United Kingdom. Uber users in London can now be matched with electric self-driving cars monitored by safety drivers, signaling a major European milestone for commercial driverless technology.

items.headline: Ronald Acuña Jr. Becomes Fastest MLB Player to Reach 200 Home Runs and 200 Steals
items.summary: Atlanta Braves outfielder Ronald Acuña Jr. hit a three-run home run against the Washington Nationals on Wednesday to become the fastest player in Major League Baseball history to reach 200 home runs and 200 stolen bases. Reaching the milestone in 904 career games, he surpassed the previous record of 929 games set by Alfonso Soriano.

items.headline: 83rd Venice Film Festival Opens as George Clooney Receives Lifetime Achievement Award
items.summary: The 83rd Venice International Film Festival officially kicked off on September 2, 2026, with the world premiere of director Danny Boyle's film 'Ink.' During the opening ceremony on the Lido, actor and director George Clooney was honored with a Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement.
